notes: Vietnam 2-level administrative model (province + ward) after the 2025 reform (34 provincial units, district level abolished nationwide 2025-07-01). Generated deterministically by scripts/address-data/import.cjs from the embedded local snapshot in scripts/address-data/source/ — no runtime network calls. Includes 6 centrally-run cities and 28 provinces, with complete ward coverage for every provincial unit (not just major cities).
